verdict.rationale: Codex is a natural-language coding agent. The docs show it can inspect code, explore unfamiliar repos, and run local tools and commands. You can pass an error screenshot with the prompt, split a larger investigation across subagents, pull in live web search, and start work from GitHub or Linear issues. One hands-on community report says it fixed hard problems quickly, which supports the core troubleshooting workflow. Missing for 10: an explicit first-party debugging or troubleshooting guide (e.g., stack-trace/log analysis, debugger integration), and broader independent corroboration of debugging quality.
